## Status Legend

- **preview-only**: Pure function, mock, or fake-client only; no real DB/Prisma/auth
- **test-only**: Unit/integration test without real DB connection
- **guard/test-only**: Guard logic built but real DB path not executed
- **dev-only**: Dev UI or server-side flag, hidden/disabled by default in production
- **real DB tested**: Actual real local/test database connection verified (A319, A321, A324, A328)

## When to Read the Archive

Only consult the archived round documents when:
- Investigating a specific historical bug or regression
- Tracing why a particular design decision was made
- Auditing the evolution of a specific file across rounds

For all other purposes, read `docs/modules/reader-sync-current-state.md` instead.
